uncertainty_note: Curves: mean and SD over five base chunks, each averaging three paired seeds and fifteen fixed backgrounds. Percentile bootstrap resamples five base clusters (10000 draws); descriptive small-sample uncertainty. Per-base seed SD is also retained. No IID p-values.
predictive_note: Exploratory, five bases only. Demean each variable within base; fit magnitude, NN, or both; leave one entire base out. Held-out outcomes are centered only to evaluate shape, not absolute out-of-state prediction. Correlation and prediction do not establish causality.
